timing: After download, schema checks and mitotic preparation; before model fitting or retrieval analysis

changes.reason: Organizer discussion 28 explicitly specifies November 23; October 13 rules change confirmation recipient to cnb@sagebase.org. This corrects the project's earlier one-day date error, while preserving frozen artifacts.

changes.value: Eight workers per arm: four real-label seeds on GPUs 0-3 and four shuffled-association controls on GPUs 4-7. Process the mitotic arm while the interphase download continues, then the interphase arm.
changes.reason: The planned shuffled-training control also needs fitting. This keeps all eight devices available for relevant tests without waiting for the larger download.

implementation_details_fixed_before_fitt.retrieval: Every eligible guide queries gene references. Its own gene reference excludes that guide; alternatives average all eligible guides. Unequal reference counts are shared by all methods and remain a limitation. Report every guide, then macro-average over genes.
implementation_details_fixed_before_fitt.exact_ties: Average ranks, including constant or zero-vector baselines
implementation_details_fixed_before_fitt.preprocessing: Drop features with >5% missing values or negligible variance in training genes. Fit center/scale from their complete-guide means; impute to training center; clip standardized values to [-10,10]. Source normalization remains reused.
implementation_details_fixed_before_fitt.abundance: Within-arm log1p guide cell count with absolute-distance retrieval; cross-arm mitotic fraction added only after both arms are complete. Counts are not measured viability.
implementation_details_fixed_before_fitt.MLP_activation: GELU; no batch normalization or label inputs
implementation_details_fixed_before_fitt.precision: BF16 autocast, FP32 parameters and score reductions, TF32 disabled; CPU FP64 similarity audit
implementation_details_fixed_before_fitt.smoke_run: Separate two-step runtime test; exclude its outputs from scientific results

observed_coverage.consequence: The published mitotic counts fail the two-guide coverage requirement. Retain this missing state; do not lower the threshold. Complete single-cell export coverage must be checked separately.
